title: The bootloader-slot check can't be skipped in an install
body: This run was started to write to a phone, and with the maintainer's override that skips the bootloader-slot check. The override is for dry runs only: nothing is ever written to a phone whose second bootloader copy was not checked.
Start the installer again without the override, or as a dry run.
footer: Nothing was sent to a phone.
Start the installer again once that is done.
